parsed.observations: Wheat leaves show numerous irregular white to greyish-white surface patches, some merging into larger colonies. Several lower leaves have yellowing, brown necrotic areas, and dried tips. The foreground leaf is blurred; no distinct rust pustules or black dots are visible.
parsed.summary: Visible white to greyish-white powdery colonies on several wheat leaves support powdery mildew, with associated yellowing and leaf necrosis.
